title: 8 Hours Exotic Car Rally Experience - Miami-Islamorada-Miami, FL
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Supercar rally from Miami to Islamorada and back on four exotic cars with a lunch stop in Islamorada is an unforgettable adventure. Whether you’re a car enthusiast or simply looking for a fun and exciting way to explore South Florida, this road trip is sure to leave a lasting impression. So, get behind the wheel of your dream car and hit the open road for an experience like no other.

Do I need insurance to drive a car from BLAST?
Yes, you have to provide a full active coverage insurance policy in your name. 

How old do I have to be to drive a car from BLAST?
You must be 25 years of age to drive our cars.
